positions.name: OwnedNotRentedThesis
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence you own from intelligence you rent, and where does the enduring value reside?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 cohere as a single directional read across many dimensions: both perform the owned-vs-rented distinction as matched opposition in aphoristic-technical register; both appeal to ownership as the value axis distinguishing self-originated from leased intelligence; both crystallize a rule through antithetical clause structure; both carry principle-level conviction in a constitutive, identity-level distinction rather than a merely arguable claim; both frame value allocation through market-pricing categories; and both argue from the structure of the concepts themselves without external authority. src-2 states the distinction (owned is not rented); src-3 locates the value (substrate is commodity, perspective is the asset you keep). The set holds no internal tension — the two expressions are parallel restatements of one thesis at the same conviction level and in the same register.
